title: Django Reinhardt and whether they met
summary: He thinks he met Reinhardt in 1948 but never played with him.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: Was Django Reinhardt still alive at that point when you were over there?
Yes, he was. Yes, he was.
Did you meet him at all?
I'm almost sure that I met him around that time.
Now he had come to America a few years earlier, I think about 1946.
And he worked in Duke Ellington's band.
Oh, I think I remember that.
Did you get a chance to hear him?
I may have. You know, the difference -- the length of time in the years? That goes back quite a ways.
Yeah, we're talking about 30 years ago.
What do they say? "A lot of water under the bridge?"
Right, right, a lot of tripe through the pot.
How was -- did you and Reinhardt ever get a chance to play together?
No, we never did, never did.
